fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Fixing the multivirus with five villains", "body": "Chance frames the multiverse plot of No Way Home as a multivirus, and he reads each of the five villains Peter fights as a different route by which illness is said to spread: Doctor Octopus as injection, Electro as electromagnetic exposure under a pink, cell-tower sky that Gabe spotted, Sandman as aerosol spraying, the Lizard as animal spillover and the Green Goblin as the airborne variant who argues with his own mask. The hosts track how often the word fix recurs, from The Daily Fix to the chip, serum and harness built to cure the villains, which Chance mocks as scientism conjured in an apartment."}, {"title": "Public and private identity", "body": "The plot turns on Peter's secret identity going public, and Gabe connects it to the public and private episode he and Chance recorded the week the film came out. In the interrogation scene Chance reads MJ as the private, feminine side who will not talk without a lawyer and Ned as the public side who spills everything, while Matt Murdock warns them about the court of public opinion. The ending returns Peter to the private as the whole world forgets him, and Chance closes by arguing that surnames and public personas make people controllable, contrasting commerce with charity."}, {"title": "Jung, Philemon and the shadow", "body": "Gabe's central thesis is that Peter Parker and Spider-Man mirror Carl Jung and his spirit guide Philemon, and the astral scene with Doctor Strange is read as Peter meeting his higher self. Chance maps the three Spider-Men onto light, shadow and integration: Tom Holland fully lit, Andrew Garfield consumed by trauma and Tobey Maguire half in shadow, with Garfield catching MJ as his redemption for Gwen Stacy. Gabe says Peter's goal is to help the villains integrate their shadow, the hosts note that the villains' cures wipe the shadow out rather than integrate it, and the hosts link all this to dissociative identity as a trend across Marvel and social media."}, {"title": "Real history woven into Marvel fiction", "body": "Gabe argues that Marvel folds real historical figures into its characters, and his headline case is Doctor Strange as Aleister Crowley, built on the legend that Yeats kicked Crowley down the stairs and on Strange's slip as his cape carries him down a staircase. Chance opens the screenshots with MJ's Joan of Arc shirt as a wink at confusing myth with history, and Gabe reads the school mural as pairing rivals, Howard Stark against Hank Pym and Einstein against Tesla. Another riff traces Jung's claimed kinship with Goethe, the Mount Brocken broadcast tower and Allen Dulles, and the hosts link MCU to MK Ultra by gematria."}, {"title": "Colors, tarot and hidden wordplay", "body": "Chance and Gabe read the film as coded in color and wordplay: an unnatural neon green Chance ties to contagion imagery in the news, blue and yellow flashes they connect to Ukraine, and purple crown energy leaking through a cracking dome. Gabe casts Peter as the Hanged Man, Strange as the Magician and Oscorp as Scorpio, the sign of the betrayal behind May's death. They trace an anagram puzzle book in Peter's room, FEAST rearranged into fates, the echidna as the she viper, the Parker Probe as a nod to Doc Ock's power of the sun, and a Statue of Liberty carrying Captain America's shield, viewed through the Mandela effect."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Chance and Gabe (Slick Dissident) decode the symbolism of Spider-Man: No Way Home in this Marvelous Demystifiers episode, reading the film's five villains as what they call a multivirus and tracing threads through Carl Jung and Philemon, tarot, anagrams and the public versus private divide. Gabe shares his theory that Doctor Strange echoes Aleister Crowley, and Chance closes with his view of the multivirus as a web of cybernetic control.
fields.Quotes JSON: [{"text": "I believe Peter Parker and Spider-Man correspond with Carl Jung and Philemon, and there are other characters in the Marvel universe that are one-to-one correspondences to real people from history.", "author": "Gabe (Slick Dissident)", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/794d3a0b-c42b-4791-84c3-f79eff430f4c/SLICK-DISSIDENT.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "Jung warned about society moving in the direction of a one-dimensional man where, instead of the integration of the shadow, the shadow is eliminated.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "It's not a terrible movie, it's entertaining, it's got a lot of good humor, but also just so much programming, especially for transhumanism.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "As much as we love these movies, they're incredibly entertaining, there is a lot of disclosure going on between the lines, and that is just something to think about.", "author": "Gabe (Slick Dissident)", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/794d3a0b-c42b-4791-84c3-f79eff430f4c/SLICK-DISSIDENT.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "It's a no-brainer with Peter Parker here, he's absolutely the Hanged Man. Doctor Strange is absolutely the Magician.", "author": "Gabe (Slick Dissident)", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/794d3a0b-c42b-4791-84c3-f79eff430f4c/SLICK-DISSIDENT.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "This is one of those murals that is showing you the mythology of scientism, which is a key part of this movie.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "The echidna in Greek mythology is the she viper, and I've done a whole series on how the echidna is very significant to the occult world.", "author": "Gabe (Slick Dissident)", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/794d3a0b-c42b-4791-84c3-f79eff430f4c/SLICK-DISSIDENT.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "His whole goal is to rescue the villains from themselves, to help them integrate their shadow, because he's Carl Jung.", "author": "Gabe (Slick Dissident)", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/794d3a0b-c42b-4791-84c3-f79eff430f4c/SLICK-DISSIDENT.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "Instead of doing the right thing because it's the right thing, we're doing the right thing because we're being told that it's the right thing.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "There is no healing other people. You heal yourself, and if you do that, then you get to be part of the process for other people to do that for themselves.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "The ultimate plan to all these mystery schools is to get your left brain to be in constant battle with your right brain, to make us fight within ourselves, and that is divide and conquer.", "author": "Gabe (Slick Dissident)", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/794d3a0b-c42b-4791-84c3-f79eff430f4c/SLICK-DISSIDENT.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "The real multivirus is the illusion of separateness created by the fracturing and fragmenting of our holistic communication web of the life force.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}]
